answer: Proof of Stake acts as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a copper entry fee to validate transactions. An attacker attempting to flood the network with umber-colored malicious nodes must acquire significant stake, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive. The network then achieves consensus by weighting influence proportionally to assets, ensuring the violet-shifting risk of low-cost identity spoofing is mitigated by the required economic risk.
